description: What to stream for: the session and its transcript, whose ids the adapter puts on the events it publishes, and what its credential is requested for, from the transcript and its profile.

allOf.description: Base schema for all adapter request payloads. Defines the metadata passthrough field that the blueprint sets for correlation. Adapters must echo it back unchanged in the response — they must not inspect or depend on its contents.

metadata.description: Opaque correlation context set by the blueprint. Echo back unchanged in the response. The adapter must not inspect or modify this field.

transcriptionSessionId.description: The session, the subject of every event the adapter publishes.

transcriptId.description: The session's transcript, on every event the adapter publishes.

provider.description: The transcription service, an entry of the transcription-services registry.

model.description: The service's model, from the transcript.

languages.description: The languages the conversation may be in, from the transcript's profile.

lastActivityAt.description: When a session carries on a transcript that's still recording, when the transcript last heard from anyone. The adapter reports from then to its first connection as a gap.

transcriptionSession.description: Link to the related TranscriptionSession resource.

transcript.description: Link to the related Transcript resource.
